identity.title: Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle—Another Beginning

leadText: Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle—Another Beginning (Japanese: 劇場版ポケットモンスター ココ ～もうひとつのはじまり～ Pocket Monsters the Movie: Koko ~ Another Beginning ~) is a short tie-in adaptation of the twenty-third Pokémon movie, Secrets of the Jungle, taking place three years before the events of the movie. It is adapted by 水野輝昭 Teruaki Mizuno.
